task: Predict the arithmetic mean runtime over four runs of a GPU SGEMM kernel multiplying two 2048 x 2048 matrices on the source workstation.
context: MWG/NWG: workgroup tile dimensions; KWG: inner tile dimension; MDIMC/NDIMC: local workgroup sizes; MDIMA/NDIMB: local memory shape; KWI: loop unrolling; VWM/VWN: vector widths; STRM/STRN: memory stride flags; SA/SB: manual-cache flags. Hardware is the fixed NVIDIA GTX 680 setup in the source. Measured runtimes are outcomes and are not inputs.
